issue.title: Flip highlights.coordinate_pdf_writes on by default after the Mac acceptance run passes

task_type_fields.proposal:
Flip the shipped default of `highlights.coordinate_pdf_writes` from `false` to `true`
once Bryan's guided real-Highlights acceptance run passes on the Mac.

Gate: run `scripts/dev/highlights_coordination_acceptance` (no arguments) on the Mac.
Its verdict prints the enable line when steps 2 (main case), 3 (frontmost and
background tab), 5 (modal sheet), and 6 (from SSH/cron) pass. If only the page position
jumped, still enable and flag a page-restore follow-up. If annotations were lost or a
conflict dialog appeared, keep the key off (Plan B territory; see
decisions:open-pdf-writes-are-coordinated "Reopens when").

Work once the gate passes: change the default in `HighlightsConfig::coordinate_pdf_writes()`
(`src/native/config/mod.rs`), update its parse tests and the key-off goldens that assume
the default, and update `docs/reference/configuration.md` (Default column, "stays off
until the Mac acceptance test passes" wording) plus the "Enabling" subsection of
`docs/highlights-ref-sync.md` "PDFs open in Highlights". The decisions strand's Cost
paragraph says the shipped default stays off until acceptance passes; write a new
decisions record or ask Bryan rather than editing an accepted record in place.

Proposed by bob-cli-at.7 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1); filed by the bob-cli-at land agent.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope:
The epic (plan:202610/highlights_coordinated_marker_writes.md, R6) deliberately shipped
the key off and made enabling wait for Bryan's hands-on acceptance run with real
Highlights, which no agent can perform. Flipping the default is the step after that run.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-at shipped coordinated PDF writes behind a default-off key until Bryan's real-Highlights acceptance run; this tracks the flip so it is not forgotten once the run passes.
